instruction.name: xvmaddwod.w.hu
instruction.description: Multiply the odd-positioned unsigned 16-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding unsigned 16-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 32-bit, and add the product to the 32-bit elements in `a`.

experiments.name: accumulator dependency chain
experiments.notes: Destination is also the accumulator; this measures the accumulator-to-result path.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvmaddwod.w.hu $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvmaddwod.w.hu $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvmaddwod.w.hu $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvmaddwod.w.hu $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvmaddwod.w.hu $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvmaddwod.w.hu $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvmaddwod.w.hu $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvmaddwod.w.hu $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
